verdict.rationale: LightSprint gates PRs through a Review Hub with an automated Merge Readiness score covering tests, design-token linting, component registry, a11y contrast and typecheck. It also lets teams save a review.md of code standards for AI agents, and gives reviewers a plain-English summary plus the diff. Nothing shows the AI posting inline review comments, or reviewing every PR automatically, including PRs authored outside LightSprint. Missing for 10: AI-generated inline PR comments, automatic review of all PRs (not just LightSprint-built tasks), documentation of an AI reviewer workflow, independent corroboration.
